summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new World Map feature (Leaflet) and the supporting backend endpoints. All 8 backend pytest cases pass and every requested frontend acceptance criterion is met: anonymous /map renders the map page, leaflet container, lantern marker for Mirewatch with a popup linking to /locations/mirewatch, while hiding the edit-map-url-btn and unplaced-card. As DM, the edit button, place/move/remove controls, place-banner, and url editor (input + save) all appear and behave correctly. Map nav link from the global header navigates to /map.

endpoints_tested: GET /api/settings -> 200 with world_map_url string (default unsplash photo)
PUT /api/entries/{id}/position (DM, null,null) -> 200, clears coords; GET shows nulls

anonymous: Lit on the Map sidebar lists placed-mirewatch
Clicking marker opens popup with map-popup-mirewatch containing 'Mirewatch' and 'Open page →' link to /locations/mirewatch
Open page link successfully navigates to /locations/mirewatch
edit-map-url-btn and unplaced-card NOT rendered for anonymous user
nav-map link in global header navigates from / to /map
dm_admin: edit-map-url-btn visible; clicking it reveals map-url-input + save-map-url-btn (map-url-editor)
placed-mirewatch row exposes replace-mirewatch (Move) and remove-mirewatch (Remove) actions
unplaced-card appears only when an unplaced location exists; place-{slug} button initiates placeMode and place-banner becomes visible; cancel-place-btn dismisses it

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/entries/{entry_id} and PUT /api/entries/{entry_id}/position only resolve by `id` (not slug), while GET /api/entries/{entry_id} accepts both id and slug. Not a bug for current UI (it passes loc.id) but inconsistent — consider supporting slug too, or document the asymmetry.
WorldMap.jsx: useEffect that loads natural image dimensions doesn't abort if mapUrl changes while a previous image is still loading. Minor race; harmless in practice.

Iteration 1 logout-cookie bug (clear_auth_cookies SameSite/Secure mismatch — see iteration_1.json) is still present in server.py lines 91-101. Not in scope for this iteration but remains an HIGH-priority hangover. The current code sets samesite='none' and secure=True with max_age=0, which actually looks correct now — appears to have been fixed since iteration 1. Re-verifying confirmed cookies clear properly via login/logout cycle during DM testing.
/api/settings GET is public (no auth) — fine as the map_url is meant to be public.
MapPositionIn permits negative or >100 values silently. Frontend clamps to 0-100 in ClickToPlace but the backend doesn't validate. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED a TEST_Unplaced_Hamlet location entry (slug test-unplaced-hamlet) to verify the unplaced-card UI branch (only Mirewatch is seeded as 'location' so unplaced list is otherwise empty). DB returned to seed state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map feature passes 100%. Seed only contains one 'location' entry (Mirewatch) which is placed by default; the unplaced-card only appears when at least one location has map_x/map_y == null. If the main agent wants the unplaced card visible by default for demo screenshots, either add a second location seed without coordinates, or temporarily clear Mirewatch's coords via PUT /api/entries/{id}/position {null,null}. Iteration 1 logout cookie bug appears fixed (cookies use SameSite=none; Secure with max_age=0).
